_about: The deep active vision models of the timeline slide, each read in its paper (evidence, quotes and figure pages in active-vision-timeline.md). date: first public release (arXiv v1). name: the model's name. cite: authors, venue and venue year. policy: how it chooses where to look: 'rl' when the choice is learned by reinforcement learning (named in method), else what it uses. row: where the label sits, -2 and -1 above the axis, 1 and 2 below, chosen so that labels do not overlap. Selection [Yohaï, 2026-10-01]: each entry precise and distinctive; STAM (CVPR 2022) was dropped: the CanViT paper does not cite it and never seeing the whole image is not what sets it apart (RAM's glimpses do not cover it either).

models.name: AME
models.method: the unobserved patch whose row of the decoder's attention map has the highest entropy
